Title: Public preview: Export Azure Monitor logs to multiple destinations

Body.Content:
You can now create 10 data export rules in a log analytics workspace and have the flexibility to decide which tables are exported and to which destination. You can define up to 10 enabled rules, to 10 different destinations (storage accounts or event hubs). The change allows you to address the followings:

  • Event hub rate limit – when destination throttles for reaching the max auto-inflate (20TUs), or the max supported limit for Standard SKU, create additional export rules to different namespace and divide tables between them.
  • Storage account rate limit - when destination throttles for reaching the limit (10Gb/s in US and Europe), create additional export rules to different storage account and divide tables between them.
  • Not all logs are relevant to the same business unit - different logs can be exported to different destinations.

Learn more.
